description: A sinister shiv that grants favor to those willing to stain its blade with a sacrifice of their own blood.
trivia: The Court of Ristul is a retinue of infernal beings who are representatives of their respective hells and the afterlife. They are led by prominent inhabitants of the Seven Hells and the afterlife that comes before it, such as the Narrow Maze.

abilities.description: Consume health to temporarily gain 25 damage for 8 seconds.

name: Dagger of Ristul
